primary_endpoint: independently verified target placement AND ordered-goal completion AND not task_failed
inference: Finite official development panel, grouped by six target substances. All 150 dev rows retained including policy failures; no iid-150 population interval. Six-cluster bootstrap is descriptive sensitivity only.
calibration: Official train 0:300 majority hidden conductivity label; tie predicts False; no dev outcome-driven tuning.
scope: Full non-model development action study. No test IDs, gold path requests, model, Jev or external network calls. Not confirmation, new-family transfer or Jev efficacy.

decision_rule.scope: Development action qualification only, never a Jev scale-up decision.
decision_rule.operational: Require all150x4 episodes and independent replay; any infrastructure failure invalidates panel; keep all scientific policy failures in150 denominator.
decision_rule.action_usefulness: Report all primary paired outcomes and six-group sensitivity. A positive measurement-minus-masked difference with positive differences in at least5 of6groups and at least95% measurement execution is a development signal for this fixed local baseline. No confirmatory p-value.
decision_rule.next: Even if positive, evaluate any learned/Jev controller against this deterministic baseline with full costs on fresh data; do not scale the existing negative branch/repair actions. A negative/imprecise result triggers mechanism diagnosis, not outcome-selected resubmission.
